capabilities: Suggest tags for the current note from trained classifiers or JSON dictionaries
Train collection-specific classifiers on existing tagged notes
Batch tag all notes or a folder with change summaries
Automatically remove blacklisted tags during suggestion and batch operations
Configure per-collection folder scopes, whitelists, blacklists, and thresholds
extras: README includes example JSON dictionaries (marketing, household, medium, in English and Italian) shipped in the repository; covers troubleshooting, debug console logging, and per-collection statistics.
motivation: The README says it is designed for vaults where one tagging approach is not enough and for users moving from manual to assisted tagging.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tag suggestion, so keeping consistent tags across many notes and folders means manual, repetitive tagging.
summary: Tag suggestion plugin that trains per-collection TF-IDF classifiers or uses static JSON dictionaries to suggest, apply, and batch tags.
